## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the result, not only a library or implementation you want added.

## Configuration and alternatives

Can this be handled by `cv.json` today? What alternatives have you considered?

## Impact

How should this work with mobile, keyboard navigation, reduced motion, no-JS
content, print, and repository-subpath deployment?
